description: R-STRING-1 through ADO: on an ACE OLE DB connection (Mode=Read), read every Field.Value and ActualSize of S and of C through server forward-only read-only recordsets; then GetString(adClipString, -1, "|", "\n", "<null>") over a client static recordset of ID, T and one of ID, M. Asks the ADO tags, BSTR byte lengths, ActualSize and GetString text for the same stored values.
retentionNote: Designed r-str-ado-act probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
